first.rationale: Shorter onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, with prior evidence of faster time-to-value and early adoption. Promotional pricing is relevant to competitor pressure but carries documented 30-day retention harm, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify both the strongest proposed intervention and the most plausible but risky alternative before committing.

final.rationale: Run a controlled experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Do not pursue promotional pricing: despite qualified revenue +18%, verified 30-day retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive first renewal.
